description: The supplied image is not a scientific figure panel. It is a single, self-contained publisher/journal graphic — the Crossref "check for updates" badge — consisting of a solid golden-yellow disc with a thick white check (tick) mark drawn across it, followed to its right by the two-line text "check for" (line 1, regular weight) and "updates." (line 2, bold), set in black sans-serif type on a plain white background. There are no axes, no axis labels or units, no scale bar, no magnification, no legend, no data points, no spectra, no micrographs, no maps, no tables and no printed numerical values of any kind. Nothing in the pixels identifies a steel, an alloy, a composition, a processing condition or a measured property. The image therefore cannot be tied to the Fe-30Mn-9Al-1C-1V-5Ni duplex lightweight steel described in the paper abstract, and it supports no microstructural or mechanical-property claim. No caption was extracted for this group, and no citation text accompanies it. It appears to be a journal-article badge that was separated from its source page and routed to the figure-extraction pipeline; the only content recoverable is the verbatim badge text "check for updates".
